name: Braised Beef Birria Empanada with Consommé (Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · Plaza de Coco (Día de los Muertos Night 2)
whyItWorks: Shredded slow-braised beef is tender, but fried pastry crust and guajillo/ancho chili birria consommé can irritate active disease.
prepOrOrderInstructions: If tasting in remission, eat the tender shredded beef from the center and skip the fried pastry corners and spicy dipping consommé.
watchOuts: Guajillo chili and onion/garlic in birria broth
